explication: LosslessSwitcher is a macOS menu-bar app that detects the playing Apple Music track’s audio format and adjusts the selected output device to match. Its main workflow receives track changes, inspects recent audio logs, chooses a supported device format, and updates the displayed sample rate; optional bit-depth detection and user scripts extend that flow. The menu also exposes device selection and persistent preferences. The graph reflects the sampled call sites and README capabilities; some parser and device-format details are only partially excerpted, so uncertain links are omitted.
